How to use Village A-Frame Cameroun

Future residents, investors and builders interested in an eco responsible A-frame village in the Littoral region of Cameroon, and the diaspora planning a return.

Open Village A-Frame Cameroun →Read the bookContact

WalkthroughMotion design, real screens

It plays by itself. Tap a dot or the arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01Get started

Five steps, five minutes.

1

Open village-aframe-hub.lovable.app.

2

Press Découvrir les modèles to see the houses, their specifications and budgets.

3

Open the gallery and the experience section to picture life in the village.

4

Run the rental profitability calculator with your own assumptions.

5

Read the FAQ, then press Nous contacter to ask for a visit or a reservation.

What is inside, and how to use it.

01Models

Models

HOW TO USE IT

  2. Compare surfaces and budgets

02Experience and gallery

Experience and gallery

What a stay or a life in the village looks like: nature, the community, the rhythm.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Scroll the gallery
  2. Read the experience
  3. Picture your use: home, rental, retreat
  4. Keep the images you like
03Rental calculator

Rental calculator

Estimate what a house could earn when rented to travellers.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Enter the nightly price
  2. Set the occupancy
  3. Read the monthly and yearly estimate
  4. Adjust and compare
04Mission and FAQ

Mission and FAQ

Why A-frames, why the Littoral, how the community builds, and the practical answers.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Read À propos
  2. Read the FAQ
  3. Write your questions
  4. Contact the team
03Tips
  • Run the calculator with a conservative occupancy first.
  • Ask for the construction timeline of the pilot.
  • A-frames are fast to build; budget the land and access separately.
  • The site is in French; write in French or English.
04FAQ
Where is the village?

A pilot in the Littoral region of Cameroon.

Can I buy one house?

Ask through the contact form; models and budgets are on the site.

Is it for rental or for living?

Both. The calculator helps you decide.

Who builds?

A community of builders; the mission page explains.
